Crucially, the dip’s depth matches the offset in candidate 0, suggesting it is a structured transient (e.g., a known reset or calibration pulse), not contamination. No trend, periodic oscillation, or irregular noise is present in any candidate. Acceptable variation includes: (a) constant offsets at 0.0 or -2.257, (b) brief symmetric triangular transients of fixed amplitude (~2.257) and duration (~2–3 points), and (c) step transitions between these levels. All segments are fully captured without boundary truncation artifacts.
